_note: Rules snapshot for Canada / Alberta. Compiled from secondary sources on the date below and NOT from primary government pages. Re-verify every value before relying on it (see sources).

stress_test.rule: qualifying rate = greater of (contract rate + buffer) or floor

default_insurance.surcharge_applies_to: first-time buyers or newly built homes choosing 30-year amortization
default_insurance.insured_price_cap_status: conflicting sources (CMHC page says 1,000,000; later reports say 1,500,000). Verify.

programs.first_time_gst_rebate: up to 100% of GST (max 50,000) on new homes up to 1,000,000, phasing out to 1,500,000. Became law 2026-03-12. Confirm eligibility and agreement dates with the builder and lawyer.
programs.alberta_new_home_warranty: mandatory 1-2-5-10 coverage for homes with permits after 2014-02-01
